messages:
Ava (Design): Hey team — we need a rapid pack of benchmark visuals for next week's webinar (THU 11am). 3 variants: social square, webinar hero banner, and a one-slide benchmark explainer. Keep to brand palette and alt-text accessibility. Figma starter: https://figma.com/file/xyz123
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Got it. Deadline for assets?
Ava (Design): EOD WED would be ideal. Quick turn; we can iterate after the dry run.
Rohit (PMM): For data — use the latest microbench (latency @ p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens), and a single comparison row vs default cloud endpoint. I can paste numbers now:
Rohit (PMM): ```
- Redwood Dedicated: p50=120ms, p95=210ms, cost=$0.25/1k
- Managed Endpoint: p50=320ms, p95=620ms, cost=$0.60/1k
```
Ava (Design): Perfect — will design around those. Need short copy options for the hero and a CTA. 2 headline variants + 1 subhead + CTA.
Priya (Growth): CTA copy options: 1) "Try the demo" 2) "See latency & cost" 3) "Compare performance". Add UTM: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=mar_apr_launch&utm_medium=social
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Also request: add tracking tags for inbound routing — campaign=webinar_apr_launch, lead_source=social. Sam, can you include a small hidden slug on the design export for analytics?
Sam (Designer): Yep — will bake the slug into the exported filename pattern and add metadata.json in the export zip.
Elena (Creative Ops): Accessibility checklist: 4.5:1 color contrast min for text, alt text for each image, and localized variants (EN/DE/FR) — mark which strings require i18n. Also flag any illustrations that might need legal review.
Ava (Design): Noted — I'll produce EN first and mark strings for i18n. Will run the contrast checker and annotate in Figma.
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Quick ask from growth: can we get a short 1:1 social teaser (1080x1080) + 9:16 story (1080x1920) optimized? Keep animation minimal — 3 frames max.
Ava (Design): Yes. Motion-safe export: GIF + MP4. Sam — can you do micro-animations?
Sam (Designer): I'll do a subtle sparkline reveal for the benchmark numbers and a fast fade for the CTA.
Priya (Growth): For messaging iterations, please include 3 headline variants and 2 tone styles (technical vs benefits-led). We'll A/B a few in socials.
Rohit (PMM): I'll drop two one-liners for benefits-led and one technical stat-led headline by EOD.
Ava (Design): Great. Also legal/brand check — is anything off-brand in the new sparkline treatment?
Miguel (Mktg Ops): cc @design-bot for automated brand checks + export checklist
design-bot: Automated check queued. Rules: color palette, logo clearspace, no-official-typeface-substitutions, export-naming. Result: pending (waiting on final frames).
Elena (Creative Ops): Once assets are in the export zip, upload to the marketing drive under /webinar/apr_launch/bench_assets and tag with release candidate v1.
Ava (Design): Plan: iterate on v1 by noon WED, hand to growth for copy tests, final exports by EOD WED.
Priya (Growth): Sounds good. I'll prep the social calendar and copy variations once Sam hands over the frames.
Miguel (Mktg Ops): One more — ensure embeds include canonical source link and we add a short attribution line: "Data: internal Redwood inference benchmarks (Mar 2026)"
Rohit (PMM): Yep adding that now.
Ava (Design): Ok locking this in. If anything blocks, ping me here. :thumbsup:
Sam (Designer): Starting now — will post first frames in this thread when ready.
design-bot: File created: /exports/2165432100_bench_v1.zip (pending content).
Ava (Design): Thanks all — appreciate the fast turn.
Miguel (Mktg Ops): Thanks team :rocket:
